summary: Nomura Holdings filed a 6-K (translation of a Corporate Governance Report submitted to the Tokyo Stock Exchange) detailing its corporate governance policies, compliance with the Corporate Governance Code, and ongoing reduction of strategic shareholdings. No special-situation corporate event—such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change—is announced in this periodic governance disclosure. The filing is a routine informational report with no transaction terms, stated price per share, premium, or deal mechanics. Thus, it does not qualify as an event-driven special situation.
